description: Bounded partial-deliverable scoring for selected active unfinished frozen criteria. Weights sum to fixed parent weight, never alter formal acceptance. Additional criteria require pre-reviewed milestone allocation; do not edit weights retrospectively.

milestones.deliverable: Real original-player source observations and source-registered five-part GLB prototype are reproducible
milestones.limitation: Experimental geometry is not the recovered or shipping 1994 mesh.

milestones.deliverable: A single authored source-controlled part-addressable rig and reversible joint transformations are maintained
milestones.limitation: Prototype articulation does not establish authentic joint positions, pose correspondence or native runtime integration.

milestones.deliverable: Source-linked blue/red pose geometry is evaluated against independent original frames and retained holdout families
milestones.limitation: Higher IoU on some frames does not establish original physical 3D geometry.

milestones.deliverable: One coherent artifact is integrated with real Windows gameplay render under source-linked identities
milestones.limitation: Pages-only previews and external model experiments cannot satisfy runtime asset integration.

milestones.deliverable: The shared pose-registered production 3D geometry qualifies across required states
milestones.limitation: Final art approval and other ART criteria remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Original silhouette and 24-frame source body references are independently reproducible
milestones.limitation: References and metrics alone do not establish correct authored proportions.

milestones.deliverable: Authentic 1994 sprite/manual projected 2D landmarks and occlusion are captured
milestones.limitation: Print 2D cannot prove original physical 3D dimensions or camera.

milestones.deliverable: One model meets prespecified blue/red silhouette and independent holdout thresholds
milestones.limitation: Local saddle/fork shape improvements are insufficient without independent generalization.

milestones.deliverable: Model remains rounded, distinctive and stable across genuine source poses
milestones.limitation: Rigid pose renders do not prove animation or 4K visual identity.

milestones.deliverable: Owner has seen and approved the original identity silhouette
milestones.limitation: Owner approval is separate from individual source-fit metrics.

milestones.deliverable: Direct-drive wheel/crank and frame/saddle mechanically linked around validated pivots
milestones.limitation: An in-memory experimental rig does not recover original joint animations.

milestones.deliverable: Original frame/phase registration supplies repeatable motion controls
milestones.limitation: Source phase observations are not themselves a 3D animation.

milestones.deliverable: Genuine chronological transitions do not introduce part overlap, mesh jumps or detachment
milestones.limitation: One static render per pose does not qualify continuity.

milestones.deliverable: Real game animation is driven by the unified source/rig with real gameplay controls
milestones.limitation: Pages motion previews do not count as runtime animation.

milestones.deliverable: Gameplay motion follows original source identity across full required transitions
milestones.limitation: User likeness review and art gate remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Source moving-course camera/tile baseline and first divergence are reproduced
milestones.limitation: Diagnostics are not proof of correct source-world presentation.

milestones.deliverable: Screen/split-band raster rules and HDMA source phase are implemented and unit-tested
milestones.limitation: Isolated parser regressions alone do not qualify full moving course.

milestones.deliverable: Actual widened course tile streaming references pass source-bound comparisons
milestones.limitation: One checkpoint does not cover changing world/split states.

milestones.deliverable: Multiple authentic moving-camera/split frames match independently held reference conditions
milestones.limitation: Synthetic capture and recomputed expected images cannot substitute for source evidence.

milestones.deliverable: Integrated Windows x64 gameplay visual sequence qualifies full widescreen camera/tiles
milestones.limitation: Real physical 4K and other QA gates remain separate.

milestones.deliverable: Unique original USA course key, unchanged controller movie and original/source hashes are pinned
milestones.limitation: Preparatory harness evidence never grants event admission.

milestones.deliverable: First causally relevant original/native divergence is resolved or independently proven unobservable
milestones.limitation: Diagnostic internal byte equality is not sufficient.

milestones.deliverable: One full original/native genuine race result and scoring outcome pair passes same-run checks
milestones.limitation: Stage-only and synthetic guest results cannot count.

milestones.deliverable: Same-run progression, independent cold-save restart and artifact receipts agree
milestones.limitation: One accepted subpart is not a complete original event.

milestones.deliverable: All first-event criteria are accepted by a separate reviewer under the event census
milestones.limitation: Formal FID gate is authoritative; this partial record never changes it.
